titles.a: Manchester United Sacked Carrick. Then Lost 4-0.

intro: Manchester United sacked Michael Carrick on 12 November, announced Mauricio Pochettino on 13 November, and lost 4-0 at Liverpool on 22 November. This video goes through the contract, the reported compensation, the match, and where United sit in the table, using only what the cited reports and tables say.
disclaimer: Figures come from the cited news reports and the Premier League table of 23 November 2026. Where reports disagree (for example Carrick's number of games), the video uses the figure two reports share and says which one it is quoting.
